import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'brand': ['Leica', 'Fuji', 'Pentax', 'Olympus', 'Leica'],
    'model_year': [2005, 2019, 2012, 2015, 2016],
    'megapixels': [13.5, 46.4, 38.7, 22.5, 12.2],
    'max_iso': [25600, 51200, 12800, 6400, 25600],
    'weight_grams': [324, 1151, 598, 1095, 290],
    'price_usd': [811.8, 3596.41, 3357.2, 1555.7, 3899.09],
    'sensor_type': ['Micro 4/3', 'APS-C', 'Full Frame', 'APS-C', 'Medium Format'],
    'has_video_4k': [1, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'lens_mount': ['E', 'EF', 'MFT', 'Z', 'MFT'],
    'body_type': ['Compact', 'Mirrorless', 'Mirrorless', 'Mirrorless', 'DSLR']
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 16))

# 1. Scatter plot: Price vs Megapixels (colored by brand)
ax1 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 1)
scatter = ax1.scatter(df['megapixels'], df['price_usd'], 
                      c=df['model_year'], s=df['weight_grams']/10, 
                      alpha=0.7, cmap='viridis', edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels')
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)')
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels\n(Size = Weight, Color = Year)')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax1, label='Model Year')

# Annotate points with brand names
for i, row in df.iterrows():
    ax1.annotate(row['brand'], (row['megapixels'], row['price_usd']), 
                xytext=(5, 5), textcoords='offset points', fontsize=9)

# 2. Bar plot: Average price by brand
ax2 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 2)
brand_price = df.groupby('brand')['price_usd'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars = ax2.bar(brand_price.index, brand_price.values, color=sns.color_palette("husl", len(brand_price)))
ax2.set_xlabel('Brand')
ax2.set_ylabel('Average Price (USD)')
ax2.set_title('Average Price by Brand')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Add value labels on bars
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax2.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 50,
             f'${height:,.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 3. Bar plot: Camera count by body type
ax3 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 3)
body_type_counts = df['body_type'].value_counts()
bars = ax3.bar(body_type_counts.index, body_type_counts.values, 
               color=sns.color_palette("Set2", len(body_type_counts)))
ax3.set_xlabel('Body Type')
ax3.set_ylabel('Count')
ax3.set_title('Camera Distribution by Body Type')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Add count labels on bars
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax3.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.1,
             str(int(height)), ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

# 4. Box plot: Price distribution by sensor type
ax4 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 4)
sensor_order = df.groupby('sensor_type')['price_usd'].median().sort_values(ascending=False).index
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='sensor_type', y='price_usd', order=sensor_order, ax=ax4)
ax4.set_xlabel('Sensor Type')
ax4.set_ylabel('Price (USD)')
ax4.set_title('Price Distribution by Sensor Type')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 5. Line plot: Camera specs over years
ax5 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 5)
df_sorted = df.sort_values('model_year')
ax5.plot(df_sorted['model_year'], df_sorted['megapixels'], marker='o', label='Megapixels', linewidth=2)
ax5.plot(df_sorted['model_year'], df_sorted['max_iso']/1000, marker='s', label='Max ISO (x1000)', linewidth=2)
ax5.set_xlabel('Model Year')
ax5.set_ylabel('Value')
ax5.set_title('Camera Specs Evolution Over Years')
ax5.legend()
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 6. Pie chart: Distribution by sensor type
ax6 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 6)
sensor_counts = df['sensor_type'].value_counts()
colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(sensor_counts)))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax6.pie(sensor_counts.values, labels=sensor_counts.index, 
                                   autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax6.set_title('Sensor Type Distribution')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 7. Heatmap: Correlation matrix
ax7 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 7)
numeric_cols = ['model_year', 'megapixels', 'max_iso', 'weight_grams', 'price_usd']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(corr_matrix, dtype=bool))
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, mask=mask, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', 
            center=0, square=True, linewidths=1, cbar_kws={"shrink": 0.8}, ax=ax7)
ax7.set_title('Feature Correlation Heatmap')

# 8. Violin plot: Weight distribution by body type
ax8 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 8)
sns.violinplot(data=df, x='body_type', y='weight_grams', ax=ax8)
ax8.set_xlabel('Body Type')
ax8.set_ylabel('Weight (grams)')
ax8.set_title('Weight Distribution by Body Type')
ax8.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 9. Stacked bar: Features by brand
ax9 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 9)
brand_features = df.groupby('brand').agg({
    'has_video_4k': 'sum',
    'model_year': 'mean'
}).reset_index()

x = np.arange(len(brand_features))
width = 0.35
bars1 = ax9.bar(x - width/2, brand_features['has_video_4k'], width, label='Has 4K Video', color='skyblue')
bars2 = ax9.bar(x + width/2, brand_features['model_year'] - 2000, width, label='Avg Year (since 2000)', color='lightcoral')

ax9.set_xlabel('Brand')
ax9.set_ylabel('Value')
ax9.set_title('Features by Brand')
ax9.set_xticks(x)
ax9.set_xticklabels(brand_features['brand'])
ax9.legend()

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
